Elabram Group oversees the global operations of Elabram HR Solution and Elabram Telco, specializing in human resources and telecommunications consulting with over 20 years of experience.

As a Frontend Developer i manage app product "Axdif" that provides a platform for task management, team communication, and employee self-service.

Project case studies:

  1. Axdif App

    • Enhanced code organization by modularizing components into seperate folders (feature-based architecture)

    • Optimized frontend performance and maintainability through strategic restructuring

    • Enforced lazy loading for faster initial load

    • Implement Cache for request to API

    • Implement library table AG Grid for some menus

    • built features AI "Analyze my perfomance" for user

    • Built advanced filtering (multi-column, saved presets, and dynamic query builder)

    • Added export/import (Excel/PDF) with data validation and template generators

    • Integrated map selection (Google Maps API) for travel submissions with geofencing

    • Redesigned drag-and-drop board with custom CDK DropLists and store to Firebase

    • Implemented skeleton loading across all async operations (UX score +35%)

    • Tech: Angular.js + PrimeNG + NgRx + Firebase

  2. Website Axdif

    • Create landing page axdif from scratch

    • Tech: Next JS + Tailwind + Framer Motion
